notes: 100 TB of pooled cloud storage per institution, at 'No cost'. Pooled across Drive + Gmail + Photos and all shared drives. Confirmed twice on Google's own pages: 'Schools and universities with Google Workspace for Education subscriptions have a baseline of 100 TB of pooled storage shared across all users' and 'Google Workspace for Education Fundamentals / Standard — 100 TB total for all End Users'.

extras.verified_at_basis: checked against the live service on 2026-11-10
extras.quota_verbatim: 100 TB of pooled cloud storage per institution, at 'No cost'. Pooled across Drive + Gmail + Photos and all shared drives. Confirmed twice on Google's own pages: 'Schools and universities with Google Workspace for Education subscriptions have a baseline of 100 TB of pooled storage shared across all users' and 'Google Workspace for Education Fundamentals / Standard — 100 TB total for all End Users'.
extras.limits_verbatim: per-object-cap 5 TB per single upload, and 750 GB per user per 24 h (upload+copy) — this is the real throttle, and it is refreshing not cumulative. request-rate: standard Drive API quota (per-project, raiseable). retention: none while the tenant is active; data survives account suspension but suspended users still consume the pool. Item cap 500 million items per user. Over-quota: at +25% or 14 days, uploads and Docs creation stop but download keeps working.
extras.egress_verbatim: Not metered for Drive reads. Google's own storage page says over-quota tenants 'can still sign in to ... view and download their files' — i.e. reads are never blocked by quota. Direct-download URLs are served from Google's edge; put behind Cloudflare if you want a cache.
extras.chaining_verbatim: One qualifying institution = one tenant = 100 TB. Google explicitly forbids multi-tenant reuse ('When a customer is approved ... they are approved for a single tenant. No user should be part of multiple tenants') and an institution with ineligible business 'must establish a separate domain for the school' — so the multiplier is *domains*, not users. Inside a tenant the multiplier is shared drives (unlimited count) and user count: up to 2,500 licenses per new domain, all drawing on the same 100 TB pool. Adding Teaching & Learning add-on licences adds 100 GB each 'with no cap' (paid).
extras.tooling_verbatim: rclone backend 'drive' (Tier 1, server-side copy, shared-drive support); Google Drive API v3; GAM (github.com/GAM-team/GAM) for admin-side bulk operations; gclone for service-account fan-out.
extras.agent_focus: Programmes that give free storage as a benefit: student / education / nonprofit / startup-benefit bundles. Which ones bundle durable, programmatically-accessible bulk storage, and does it renew?

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
